en: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.
mz: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. A building plinth area hi 574.875 Square metres niin building hi floor nga (5) a sak a ni a. First floor hi Agriculture leh marketing lama training leh awareness centre atan ruahman niin mihring 300 vel leng tura hisap a ni. Ground floor ah hian guest room, conference/meeting room te awmin Basement I ah hian mi 78 lenna market area bakah market office ruamhan niin Basement II ah mi 85 lenna market area niin Basement III hi motor 25 lenna parking area-a ruahman a ni. en: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 191/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati who is on an official tour of Serchhip District visited Sainik School, Chhingchhip, a few miles away from Serchhip town today. Upon his arrival, Governor was accorded the Guard of Honour by 8 Bn of Assam Rifles. He was then introduced to the staff by Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer. A briefing about the School to Governor was given by the Principal in his office room. After this, an official function with a cultural program was organized inside the Assembly Hall in honour of the esteemed visitor. Here, the Governor addressed the students. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati congratulated faculties for their best effort to keep up with other establishwd Sainik Schools in the country. He thanked the state government for bring up a highly valuable asset of national importance in education like Sainik school here in Mizoram. He expressed his pride of having the first Sainik School in the country where girl students are admitted. He stressed the importance of Sainik Schools for preparing the young students to become cadet officers in Army, Airforces and Navy. Beside this, he said the school also prepared the students to become role model students and role model citizen. He reminded the students of the school about their important duties for the national integration of the county. Full speech of the Honble Governor : https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 The programme began with welcome address by Maj S.Kalyan, Admn and concluded with vote of thanks proposed by WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip. After the official programme, Governor inspected the facilities inside the campus of Sainik School Chhingchhip. As per the briefing by the Principal, here are the few highlights of the school. The school is now 6 years old and running with the pilot cadets in Class XI. The annual intake of students are 60 boys and 10 girls in the class VI while in the class IX only boys are admitted with the availability of 10 seats for students annually. The annual fee per a student is estimated at Rs 1.85 lakh per year. The schools have daily routine for winter and summer and winter with the physical and classroom activities through out the day. It usually starts from very early morning till 9:00 to 9:30 PM at night. Apart from the facilities for cocurricular activities, the School is also currently having the facilities like Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc.,. The swimming pool, parade ground and other big sports facilities are being planned to be added very soon. The Principal highlighted the status of Grant in Aid from the state, issues with water and power bills, LMV ambulance to be received from the Mizoram Rural Bank through CSR, INSAS rifles to be received from Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Infrastructural Fund received to the tune of Rs 99,96,000 the Ministry of Defence with the proposed implementations. To solve the issue with high power bills, the Governor advised implementation of Solar Power Generation plant inside the campus. While, the issue with high water bills is being taken up the office Deputy Commissioner and is expected to be solved very soon. Governor in his visit to Sainik School, Chhingchhip was escorted and given a company by Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC and Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District. en: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 151/2023-2024 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei inaugurated a newly renovated Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) here in Lunglei town, today. Lunglei PS building was constructed wayback in 1991 and the building became dilapidated and worn out.Lunglei PS building is a two storey building. Lunglei High Powered Committee Funded this renovation works, at the tune of Rs.15 lakh for each storey. Rs.15 lakh was released for the year 202-2023 which was being used for renovation of Ground Floor, which was inaugurated today. Fund for 1st Floor renovation is also released for the year 2023-2024 and renovation works will be carried out by Police dept, at their earliest. In his augural speech Pu Lawmawma highlighted that Lunglei PS managed to bag the Best Police Station of India Award during 2022-2023.It is quite befitting that the building is also renovated to become the best PS building in Mizoram. He applauded the renovation works executed by PS staff with their all out efforts and with a spirit of love and ownership to get the best result. He exhorted them, since they could manage to bag the Best PS Award too, to try for the Best in traffic management in the whole India. He implored PS staff to be friendly and polite all the time, so that the public will not have any hesitation and fear in approaching the Police station in their time of troubles and distresses. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) and Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC delivered speeches in this function as well. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) informed the gathering public how HPC had helped police dept. time and again since many past years and said that renovation works was just one amongst many. He entreated and reminded the police dept. to pay back many blessings they had received from various quarters by rendering their best services to the society. Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC Lunglei heartily congratulated PS staff for their newly renovated building and applauded them for their dedication and hard work put forth in their renovation works and added that it was worth emulating for other depts. Todayâ€™s brief inaugural function was presided over Pu K.Beihmotaosa MPS,Addl.SP Lunglei and Pu Rahool Alwal IPS, SP Lunglei delivered welcome speech,and technical report was given by Pu L.P Zohmangaiha,OC Lunglei PS. en: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 AT SIAHA District Task Force,Siaha mulled over how to take preventive measures against Covid-19 pandemic in the emergency meeting held, here at Siaha. District Magistrate had already issued prohibitory order on last Friday(7/3/2020), the order prohibited Cross- border movement between Myanmar and India through passages/roads that linked Myanmar and 10 villages within Siaha district namely: : Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki and Khopai village. The Same order highlighted that Check points will be set up at 3 villages namely: Kaochao, Tlapi and Tipi Ferry which located at Inter District Border. In pursuant to the said prohibitory Order, Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have left for those 10 villages to call for GramSabha meeting and to sensitize about Covid-19 and Prohibitory Order. Today's meeting resolved that villagers of those 10 villages be requested to form a joint committee comprising of Church, NGOs and Village council to vigil over border passage/road that linked their respective village and Myanmar.The meeting also resolved that MADC Forest Guard and India Army stationed at villages located India-Myanmar Border be requested to help proposed village's Joint committee in their vigilant works on Border road/passage. Today's meeting also decided that on the 13th&14th March,2020 a Team comprising Medical officials, Leaders of NGOs, Joint VC members, Police personnel and DC office staff will visited those 13 villages and witness preventive measures taken by each village and carry out sensitization campaign as well. CMO & DMS informed the meeting that there was only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor and 15 Personal Protection Equipments (PPE) presently at Siaha; and 2 TIRS will arrive shortly. TIRS and Self Reporting Format will be placed at check points; and by using TIRS leh Self reporting format; suspected Covid-19 infected travellers will be identified and quarantine for 20 days.
